player_prompt.intro:
Nin hi Player {player_id} ni, Pig Dice game khel turin.

Dan:
- I turn ah, '[roll]' emaw '[hold]' i ti thei
- 2-6: I turn total ah add
- 1: I turn total chhuah let, turn titawp
- Hold: I turn total i score ah add, turn titawp
- Points {winning_score} thleng hmasa ber in chak

I turn a lo thleng thin, hriat tur i lang ang. Current scores leh turn total i hmu ang.
'[roll]' ti ila, die roll rawh, emaw '[hold]' ti ila, i points bank rawh.
